item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello! Lovely to see you. Here's your weather for Thursday, September 24. Thursday. Nearly there! Here in Shanghai, the day will be dull and cloudy. The high will be 31 degrees, and the low will be 24 degrees. It's going to be a real scorcher. There is almost no chance of rain today. There are 1 days to go until a special day. Can you guess which one? It's going to be hot. Drink lots of water and wear a hat! And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be showery, with a high of 33 degrees. Have you thought any more about harvest? And that's the weather. Have a brilliant day!
